raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

Kubernetes and Dynamo need the standard `grpc.health.v1.Health` protocol on SGLang's Python-runtime native gRPC frontend. Readiness must also distinguish a healthy paused engine from one that can currently accept inference work.

This PR incorporates and supersedes #40129 by @tmonty12, preserving its `tonic-health` integration and event-driven engine-state publication while adding the lifecycle-aware health contract.

## Changes

- Register the standard `grpc.health.v1.Health` service on the existing inference gRPC listener.
- Expose two named entries: `inference` and `liveness`.
- Map `inference = healthy && !is_pause` and `liveness = healthy`.
- Seed both statuses before the listener accepts requests.
- Reuse `EngineStatePublisher`; health requests do not poll Python or run synthetic inference.
- Publish only visible status changes to connected `Watch` clients.
- Publish terminal `NOT_SERVING` for both entries before closing watch streams and the listener.
- Preserve the custom `HealthCheck` and `WatchEngineState` RPCs.

| `healthy` | `is_pause` | `inference` | `liveness` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `true` | `false` | `SERVING` | `SERVING` |
| `true` | `true` | `NOT_SERVING` | `SERVING` |
| `false` | `false` | `NOT_SERVING` | `NOT_SERVING` |
| `false` | `true` | `NOT_SERVING` | `NOT_SERVING` |

The separate Rust `sglang.api.v1` frontend is intentionally out of scope.

## Validation

- `cargo +1.93.1 fmt --all --check`
- `cargo +1.93.1 test -p sglang-grpc` — 20 passed
- `cargo +1.93.1 clippy -p sglang-grpc --all-targets -- -D warnings`
- Python gRPC bridge unit tests — 7 passed, 8 subtests passed

No model execution or inference hot-path behavior changes.

@@ -160,6 +160,31 @@ def test_observable_state_notifies_only_on_changes(self):
         self.manager.gracefully_exit = True
         self.assertEqual(self.notifications, 3)
 
+    def test_runtime_handle_registers_callback_with_manager(self):
+        handle = RuntimeHandle.__new__(RuntimeHandle)
+        handle.tokenizer_manager = self.manager
+        callback = object()
+
+        handle.set_engine_state_changed_callback(callback)
+
+        self.assertIs(self.manager._engine_state_changed_callback, callback)
+
+    def test_health_ignores_pause_and_rejects_unhealthy_lifecycle_states(self):
+        handle = RuntimeHandle.__new__(RuntimeHandle)
+        handle.tokenizer_manager = self.manager
+        for status, exiting, expected in [
+            (ServerStatus.Starting, False, False),
+            (ServerStatus.Up, False, True),
+            (ServerStatus.UnHealthy, False, False),
+            (ServerStatus.Up, True, False),
+        ]:
+            for paused in (False, True):
+                with self.subTest(status=status, exiting=exiting, paused=paused):
+                    self.manager.server_status = status
+                    self.manager.gracefully_exit = exiting
+                    self.manager.is_pause = paused
+                    self.assertEqual(handle.health_check(), expected)
+
     def test_graceful_exit_notifies_and_changes_computed_health(self):
